{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Fighting |type2=Steel |jtrainername=ゲン |jpokemonname=ルカリオ |trainername=Riley |pokemonname=Lucario |tmtrainername=Gen |tmpokemonname=Lucario |image=[[File:Riley Lucario.png|270px]] |caption=Riley's Lucario |location=[[Sinnoh]] |gender=Male (core series, Pokémon Adventures)| |epnum=DP110 |epname=Steeling Peace of Mind! |prevonum=448 |noevo=incap |current=[[Party|With Riley]] |enva1=[[Bill Rogers]] |java1=[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]] }} '''Riley's Lucario''' (Japanese: '''ゲンのルカリオ''' ''Gen's Lucario'') is the primary {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Riley]]. ==In animation== [[File:Riley and Lucario.png|thumb|left|220px|Lucario and Riley]] ===History=== ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== Lucario debuted in ''[[DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!]]'' on [[Iron Island]]. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} traveled there after being contacted by {{an|Barry}}, they found the local {{type|Steel}} Pokémon fighting brutally against each other. When a crazed {{p|Aggron}} attacked Ash, [[Riley]] stepped in and had {{p|Lucario}} attack it with {{m|Close Combat}}. Despite being a Steel-type as well, Lucario wasn't affected like the others of its type due to its strong [[aura]]. With Lucario’s aura, they found the source of the problem: A machine operated under [[Mars]]'s command that was using the [[Spear Key]] to create low frequency waves which tortured the Steel Pokémon. Lucario attempted to read the Aura coming out of the machine, but at that time, Mars placed the Spear Key into a pillar at the Iron Ruins. The pulses of energy beam overwhelmed Lucario and caused it to rebel against Riley, even breaking its {{i|Poké Ball}} in half when he tried to [[recall]] it. Even then, however, Lucario wasn't completely under the machine's influence and tried to destroy the machine but couldn't do it. Ash managed to finish the job and destroy the machine, so Lucario and the other Steel types were brought back to their senses. When Mars realized her plan was shot, she fled and attempted to blow up Iron Island with explosives, but her efforts were thwarted when both Riley and Lucario used their auras to contain the blast and send it flying. Following the arrival of [[Professor Carolina]], Riley and Lucario decided to remain on Iron Island to investigate the Iron Ruins further. ===Personality and characteristics=== Lucario possesses a great deal of strength and is selfless in its approach, much like its Trainer. While it has a stoic manner, its good intentions are clear. Lucario works completely in sync with [[Riley]], making them a formidable duo of [[Aura Guardian]]s. It relies on its [[aura]] abilities which provide Riley with incredible insight, as seen through their [[Team Galactic]] counter-operation. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fighting|steel|Riley Lucario {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bone Rush|1=Close Combat|2=Aura Sphere}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bone Rush|1=Close Combat|2=Aura Sphere}}}} {{anmov|fighting|Close Combat|DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!}} {{anmov|fighting|Aura Sphere|DP110|Steeling Peace of Mind!}} {{anmov|ground|Bone Rush|DP111|Saving the World From Ruins!}} {{anmov/f|steel}} ==In the games== ===In the [[core series]]=== When the {{player}} teams up with [[Riley]] at [[Iron Island]], {{p|Lucario}} is the Pokémon he will use in [[Double Battle]]s against [[wild Pokémon]] and enemy {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. {{color2|000|Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}} |} ===In the [[spin-off games]]=== ====[[Pokémon Masters EX]]==== {{main|Riley (Masters)#Lucario|Riley (Masters) → Lucario}} Riley forms a [[sync pair]] with Lucario in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. {{PairDex/h|Steel|Fighting}} {{PairDex|195|Riley|trainerlink=Riley (Masters)#Lucario|trainerimg=Riley|0448|Lucario|dynamax=yes|gender=male|Fighting|Fire|Sprint|exrole=Physical Strike|6|Special Sync Pair Event}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Riley Lucario Adventures.png|thumb|150px|Lucario in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:Lucario moveset.png|thumb|left|150px|Lucario using the four moves in succession]] Lucario first appears in ''[[PS378|Grumpy Gliscor]]'' along with his Trainer [[Riley]] on [[Iron Island]] waiting for {{adv|Diamond}} to arrive so that they can train him and improve his battling skills. After he arrives, they begin their training. Lucario is pitted against [[Tru]], Don, and {{adv|Lax}}, and with strong moves like {{m|Close Combat}} and {{m|Aura Sphere}}, he puts them into a tight spot before catching [[Tru]]'s {{m|Wood Hammer}} and holding him while his Aura Spheres fall from the sky and defeat Diamond's Pokémon. Lucario then oversaw Diamond's training along with Riley, but during their training, he senses something with his Aura that turns out to be two {{tc|Roughneck|Cue Ball}}s who have stolen a [[Pokémon Egg]]. The Cue Balls blind Riley and Lucario with {{p|Vespiquen}} honey and prevent them from using their [[Aura]] with a {{p|Mothim}}'s {{m|Air Slash}}, they are defeated by Dia's newest technique: the "Mach-one-and-only-Razor-Leaf" and are left to suffer the wrath of Lucario who beats them with {{m|Close Combat}}, {{m|Aura Sphere}}, {{m|Bone Rush}}, and {{m|Flash Cannon}} in quick succession. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|fighting|steel|Riley Lucario {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Aura Sphere|1=Bonemerang|2=Close Combat|3=Flash Cannon}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Aura Sphere|1=Bonemerang|2=Close Combat|3=Flash Cannon}}}} {{anmov|steel|Flash Cannon|PS378|Grumpy Gliscor}} {{anmov|fighting|Close Combat|PS379|Lucky Lucario I}} {{anmov|fighting|Aura Sphere|PS379|Lucky Lucario I}} {{anmov|ground|Bone Rush|PS381|Vexing Vespiquen & Unmanageable Mothim I}} {{anmov|ground|Bonemerang|PS418|Deprogramming Porygon-Z|rec=yes|x=yes}} {{anmov/f|steel|x=manga}} ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== [[File:Riley Lucario DPA.png|thumb|150px|Lucario in Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] Lucario first appears in ''[[DPA10|Serious Training on Iron Island!!]]'' as it rescues Hareta from {{m|Rollout|an attack}} caused by [[B-2]]'s {{p|Graveler}}. Later, it takes on B-2's {{p|Drapion}} where it tried to use Aura Sphere, but fails due to Drapion's 360 rotation effect. Lucario was able to take out Drapion with the teamwork of [[Hareta]]'s {{p|Riolu}} given from Riley when it was an {{pkmn|Egg}}. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|fighting|steel|Riley Lucario Aura Sphere DPA.png|Using Aura Sphere}} {{anmov|fighting|Aura Sphere|DPA10|Serious Training on Iron Island!!}} {{anmov/f|steel}} ==Trivia== * Lucario is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Flash Cannon}}. ==Related articles== {{animespecies|Lucario}} * [[Lucario (M08)|Sir Aaron's Lucario]] {{Project Anime notice|no}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Lucario}} [[Category:Animation characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Male characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Diamond and Pearl characters]] [[Category:Platinum characters]] [[Category:HeartGold and SoulSilver characters]] [[Category:Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl characters]] [[Category:Pokémon with manga move errors]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[de:Urs’ Lucario]] [[es:Lucario de Riley/Quinoa]] [[it:Lucario di Fabiolo]] [[ja:ゲンのルカリオ]] [[zh:亞玄的路卡利歐]]
